expected_idle.reason: Arcane Blast costs no mana and sits ahead of the wand line, so once Frostbolt is unaffordable the character casts Arcane Blast and never reaches the wand; the rotation search measured this as the best use of those globals.

Ice Lance fires on a Fingers of Frost charge and only then (the line asks the engine whether the aura exists before it asks whether it is up, so a character with the Ice Lance talent and no Fingers of Frost point does not spam it). The ladder's level-30 character has spent the Ice Lance point but not yet a Fingers of Frost point, so the line is idle on that one rung; from 38 on it casts.

Cone of Cold waits for five Winter's Chill stacks and a target within its 10 yards. The ladder's level-30 character has not spent a Winter's Chill point, so the target never carries the aura; at higher rungs and at raid 60 the character stands at 30 yards, out of the cone's reach, so the line stays idle there too (casters lane M9, round 14).

notes: Rotation-accuracy program, wand-weaving addition (2026-09-28): Shoot (5019) is declared inert because this build's item table has no wand with required_level <= 10, so the ladder's level-10 rung equips nothing in the ranged slot and core.RegisterShootSpell never registers the spell there; from level 20 on it resolves and fires heavily (up to 77 percent of top casts) on this bare, no-consumes, no-buffs ladder character. Vanilla Frost at 60 is Frostbolt spam: with no Fire talents, working a Fire Blast cast into the rotation spends a global that Frostbolt would otherwise fill, for less damage -- the engine lane's spec tasks measured a 2.0 percent (FullBuffs) to 5.6 percent (NoBuffs) DPS loss versus Frostbolt alone, so Fire Blast is left out of the default rotation. Cold Snap and Ice Lance are the spec's own utility and are handled by Frost-specific logic, not this priority list. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/ (the one its manifest.json records last). 2026-10-07: the Arcane Blast line is gone - it was adopted while the engine registered the spell free; the client charges 15% of base mana per cast, and on that engine the line measures no effect at all. 2026-10-07: Fingers of Frost is implemented (15 percent per Chill application, 1 or 2 charges for 15 sec, the next damaging cast counts as Frozen), so Ice Lance is cast on a charge; with the Fingers of Frost build the rotation search measured it as a missing line beyond the combined error, see design/reviews/2026-10-07-frost-fingers-of-frost.md. 2026-10-21 (ladder rotations lane): the Ice Lance line asks whether the Fingers of Frost aura exists before it asks whether it is up. The engine only registers the aura once the talent has a point, and a condition on an aura that does not exist is dropped, which left the line unconditional: a level-30 mage with the Ice Lance point and no Fingers of Frost point cast Ice Lance every global and never Frostbolt. Caster tier lane (2026-10-31): two Forever Frost mechanics the rotation never used. Ice Barrier (talent taken in the guide build) was never cast, so its 3% + 3% Frost damage was missing; it is now cast before the pull and kept up. Winter's Chill (Forever rework: Frostbolt and empowered Ice Lance stack it to 5, the mage's next Cone of Cold spends it) was stacked and never spent; Cone of Cold now fires on five stacks, after Ice Lance (the order measured best). About +3% and +3% at the level-60 raid band, beyond the combined error. Caster tier lane 2 (2026-10-31): the engine now refuses Cone of Cold when the mage stands beyond the cone's 10 yards (12 with Arctic Reach). The ranker stands casters at 30 yards, so the tier list no longer counts a Cone of Cold a ranged raid frost mage would not cast; the line stays for a character placed within reach. Theorycraft audit fix (casters.md R1, R2): the raid build takes Missile Barrage 2/2 and Arcane Focus 3/5 (Arcane Missiles is an Arcane spell) with the points from Wand Specialization and three of Winter's Chill, which at range only feeds the mage's own Cone of Cold; Winter's Chill keeps 2 points so Ice Barrier still has its 30 tree points. Arcane Missiles is cast on every Missile Barrage proc. About +7 percent in that run. Sim-accuracy round 4 (design/reviews/2026-11-01-sim-audit-round4/casters.md): the Missile Barrage line casts Arcane Missiles rank 7 (10212); rank 8 (25345) is an Ahn'Qiraj book rank, not learnable in Phase 1. Guide rewrite (2026-11-02): the opener is played as in game, Ice Barrier at -4 s and a Frostbolt at -2.5 s that lands at the pull; about +1.6% with raid buffs and +1.5% without.

Forever Sixty default rotation, unvalidated until the nightly job runs

priorityList.notes: Evocation when you are nearly dry and more than 30 seconds of the fight remain. It is an 8 second channel at +1500% mana regeneration on an 8 minute cooldown, so it comes once a fight: spend your mana gem from 28 and a mana potion first, and at 60 a Demonic Rune too. Inside the last 30 seconds the mana comes back too late to spend, so keep casting.

Ice Barrier whenever the shield is down. The talent adds 15% Frost damage for a minute after the cast and another 5% while the shield holds, so it is your biggest damage buff. It has a 30 second cooldown: put it up before the pull and recast it the moment it breaks or runs out.

Ice Lance while Fingers of Frost is up and its 8 second cooldown is ready. The charge makes the boss count as frozen, so Ice Lance hits for four times its damage with Shatter's 50% crit. From 31 Fingers of Frost gives two charges and Ice Lance spends one, so your next Frostbolt gets the other.
Arcane Missiles the moment Missile Barrage lights up. The proc makes it free, halves the channel and fires a missile every half second; Frostbolt procs it 20% of the time with Missile Barrage 2/2.

Cone of Cold on 5 Winter's Chill stacks above half mana, from within 10 yards. Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost Ice Lances build the stacks, and Cone of Cold spends 5 of them for double damage and 35% more of your spell damage. The cone reaches 10 yards, 12 with Arctic Reach, so it only comes up on a boss that lets you stand that close; from 30 yards, skip it.
Frostbolt is the filler, and you never stop casting it to wait on a proc. Once Fingers of Frost at 30 and Missile Barrage at 51 are in, every cast can roll one.

Shoot only when you are out of mana and waiting on a gem, a rune or Evocation. A wand shot cannot start during the global cooldown, so it never fits between spells; once you are shooting, the first shot fires half a second after you press it and the rest come at the wand's speed until you cast again.
